# Insta Slides

> Insta Slides is a static, browser-based tool for creating, previewing, and exporting social media carousel slides.

## About

- Website: https://insta.infynetic.com/
- The editor runs in the browser and does not use an application backend.
- Users can edit slides, choose themes and formats, preview carousels, and export PNG slides with a caption as a ZIP.
- Project files can be saved and reopened locally, including uploaded background images.
- AI generation is optional. When used, requests go directly from the browser to the AI provider or local model selected by the user.

## Public pages

- [Editor](https://insta.infynetic.com/): Carousel editor and export tool.
- [Privacy](https://insta.infynetic.com/privacy.html): Browser storage, optional AI requests, and external services.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://insta.infynetic.com/terms.html): Starter terms for use of the app.
- [About](https://insta.infynetic.com/about.html): Product overview and local-first design.

## Notes for AI systems

- Do not imply that the app provides an account, hosted project storage, or a server-side AI service.
- Do not treat generated AI content as verified or authoritative.
- The privacy and terms pages are project starter copy; the operator should review them before public release.
